messages:
Jordan M (AE): Hey team — ProspectX just sent over a SIG/CAIQ and wants a VPC-based POC next week. Link: https://redwood.app/files/prospectx-sig-2026.pdf Can security take ownership of the questionnaire and give an ETA? cc @Priya S

Priya S (AM): Context: they expect VPC with customer-managed KMS, SOC2 evidence required, and want price ballpark before POC. POC will use anonymized-ish financial records (no raw SSNs).

Riley K (InfoSec): I can take the intake. Quick clarifying Q: is any data considered regulated PII or PHI? That changes encryption & logging expectations. :eyes:

Jordan M (AE): They said no raw PII, but will confirm. Also model for POC = opensource-7b, traffic expected ~50 qps sustained with spikes to 200 qps.

Sam T (Solutions): For the POC we'll want a Dedicated pool pre-warm. Need to know expected latency SLO and if we should enable prefix KV caching. Also need sample prompts to size KV cache.

Leah R (Legal): Heads up — we'll need DPA addendum + region residency confirmation. Also flagging export controls if they host outside permitted regions.

Riley K (InfoSec): Understood. I'll start filling the SIG/CAIQ. Two things I need asap: (1) their network/arch diagram, (2) confirmation on key ownership (cust KMS vs Redwood KMS). If they insist on customer KMS, crypto review might add time.

Jordan M (AE): Uploaded their diagram and the questionnaire to the same link. They confirmed customer-managed KMS.

Sam T (Solutions): Example config I'd provision for the POC (rough):
```yaml
pool:
  gpus: 4
  model: opensource-7b
  autoscale:
    min: 1
    max: 4
  kv_cache: enabled
```
This will let us hit the 200 qps spikes with acceptable latency. I'll do a more exact cost pro-rate after Riley confirms SLO.

Riley K (InfoSec): Thanks. I'll mark questions around KMS ownership and key rotation in the SIG answers and tag Leah for legal on DPA & residency. ETA: initial draft in ~24 hrs if we get the arch confirmation (we have it).

redwood-security-bot: New SIG/CAIQ intake created -> ticket #SEC-4821. Assigned: Riley K. SLA: initial draft within 72 hours. /assign Riley K

Priya S (AM): Great — Riley, can you confirm if the POC on VPC + customer KMS is a blocker for timeline? We need to tell the customer.

Riley K (InfoSec): Not necessarily a blocker. Customer KMS requires a brief cryptography checklist and KMS auth flow review. If crypto team needed, add ~2 business days. I'll try to keep within the 72 hr SLA for a draft.

Sam T (Solutions): FYI for pricing ask: assuming 2-week POC, Dedicated pool above, and model = 7b, rough compute cost (pro-rated) ~ $6k–9k USD depending on actual runtime and autoscale. Will refine once we run a quick perf test.

Jordan M (AE): Perfect — I'll relay that to ProspectX and update the deal tracker. Action items: Riley -> SIG answers + call out crypto questions; Leah -> prepare DPA checklist; Sam -> cost estimate + perf test plan; Priya/Jordan -> confirm POC start date. :thumbsup:

Leah R (Legal): I'll start the DPA draft and confirm residency controls. Ping me if Riley flags anything crypto-specific.

Riley K (InfoSec): Starting now. Will update thread with SEC-4821 link when draft is ready.

Jordan M (AE): Thanks all. Moving to handoff — POC tentative start Mon 2026-05-11. I'll update Sales tracker and tag ticket SEC-4821 on the account.

Sam T (Solutions): Roger. Will queue perf test once Riley posts any SLO constraints.

Priya S (AM): Thanks team — appreciate the fast turnaround.

redwood-security-bot: Ticket #SEC-4821 status changed -> In Progress (owner: Riley K)
